headline: Console class dependencies and structure
what_breaks: rich/text.py — relies on Console for rendering text
rich/segment.py — depends on Console for segment management
rich/color.py — uses Console for color management
why: This file serves as a core component for rendering in the Rich library, heavily utilized by multiple modules. Changes here can affect the rendering capabilities and overall output of the console interface.
checklist: Review changes to ConsoleOptions and ConsoleDimensions classes
Check interactions with rich/text.py and rich/segment.py
Ensure compatibility with existing ColorSystem implementations
